confirmed.description: Nagoji's tunic sleeves are rolled up to the elbows, leaving both forearms bare down to the wrist bandages. verdict.reason:
I could not refute this. In page 8, panel 8.1 (original pixels about x870-1150, y540-1000, zoomed 3x and 6x), both of Nagoji's tunic sleeves are clearly rolled into thick cuffs just above the elbows. Both forearms are bare down to the linen wrist wraps.

The script requires the opposite. The bible's chapter 5 row does not mention sleeves, but nothing in the bible or the script allows them rolled up in this scene.

Two things keep this major rather than blocker. The brand is not shown: the inner left forearm faces his body and no mark is drawn, so the reveal is not given away. And the error is limited to one figure in one panel.

confirmed.description: The script's key beat is that the old woman's eyes have already gone past Ibrahim to Nagoji on the cart. In the art she looks up into Ibrahim's face as she marks his forehead, so 'That one carries storms in his bones' reads as being about Ibrahim, not Nagoji.

verdict.reason: Confirmed as major. The script for 5.3 asks for a specific staging: "Her eyes have already gone past him to Nagoji on the cart, lit by its lantern." Neither CONTINUITY.md nor the adaptation notes relax this. I zoomed the panel at 4x and 10x. The old woman is turned three-quarters toward Ibrahim, chin raised, eyes rolled up and to the right. That points at her own ash-marking hand on Ibrahim's bowed forehead, which is a few inches from her face. Nagoji sits small and far off in the top-right background. The straight line from her eyes to his face only just clears the top of Ibrahim's turban, and her head and eyes do not tell the reader she is looking past Ibrahim. At print size she plainly reads as looking up at the man she is marking. The beat the script relies on (the old woman seeing Nagoji) is not drawn, so the storms line, a plant for the chapter's closing "Horses. Guns. Storms.", first lands on Ibrahim. The flaw is only partly softened: "That one" is third-person phrasing, Nagoji is in the frame, and Ibrahim's "I told her you carry horses there too" in 5.4 sorts it out one panel later. That keeps it from being a blocker, since the line and the beat survive and nothing needs rewriting. It is still a clearly wrong eyeline on a key line, confined to one panel. Fix: redraw 5.3 with her face and eyes turned past Ibrahim's shoulder toward Nagoji on the lit cart while her hand stays on Ibrahim's brow.

verdict.reason: I confirmed this on page 7, panel 7.3 using a crop at 300 DPI (page x 920-1695, y 695-1235). Each of the two lower balloons sits on the wrong speaker's side. The official's line '<You know their forts?>' is lower left, over Nagoji's waist. Its tail runs right and ends in the empty floor just past Nagoji's right arm (about 385,355 in the crop), well short of the official's head. Nagoji's 'Some.' is lower right, on the official's shoulder and back. Its tail runs up and left to Nagoji's right elbow (about 355,300), not to his face. minors.description: Ibrahim's scar is missing where his left cheek faces the camera. He is turned three-quarters to screen left with his left ear showing, but there is no scar from that ear to the jaw.
minors.evidence: page-03.png full-res around x 990-1100, y 390-500: clean cheek beside the left ear. 5.2: page-05 around x 400-520, y 910-1020: the same.

minors.description: The ash smear on Ibrahim's forehead cannot be made out, although the page 6 cast block says he keeps it 'in every panel to the end of the chapter'. It is clearly drawn in 6.2 and 6.3, so the mark comes and goes.
minors.evidence: page-06.png full-res around x 440-540, y 390-470: the forehead under the turban edge shows at most a trace of grey.

minors.description: A net-mender at the right edge looks like Ibrahim and appears in the same panel as him: a man of the same age with a full grey-flecked beard and a pale wrapped head cloth. On a quick read he looks like a second Ibrahim. Giving him a bare head or a clean chin, or making him clearly younger, would fix it.
minors.evidence: page-03.png full-res around x 1400-1520, y 560-660, compared with Ibrahim at about x 970-1120, y 370-520 in the same panel.

minors.description: Kanka has a white streak or blaze on her forehead above the eye. The approved Kanka sheet is solid black with no white markings, so the mare in this deliberate echo of Chapter 1 does not match her sheet.
minors.evidence: page-02.png full-res around x 440-560, y 1700-1790: a hard-edged white mark between the mane and the eye. Compare 19-kanka-v15.png, where the coat and face are all black.

minors.description: Nagoji's moustache is a drooping walrus shape rather than the thick curled moustache on his sheet. His tunic-shirt also has a buttoned placket, though the script says 'no buttons, no collar'. The same buttons appear in 3.1, 4.3 and 5.5.
minors.evidence: page-09.png full-res around x 150-520, y 1980-2220: the moustache ends hang down, and buttons are visible down the shirt front. 3.1 (page-03, about x 720-900, y 400-560) shows a split placket with buttons.

minors.description: A long thin pale line runs from the brand down the forearm toward the elbow, with a second line on the upper arm. This looks like the long white forearm scar, which the bible gives him only from Chapter 9 (@5.2). In Chapter 5 the forearm should carry the ridged brand alone.
minors.evidence: Zoomed crop of the foreground forearm in 1.3 (about x250-700, y1880-2140): a thin white streak leaves the netted brand patch and runs toward the elbow crease. A separate pale streak crosses the upper arm.

minors.description: In 1.1 the brand is drawn as a small starburst of crossing white strokes, while 1.3 shows a netted, ridged pale patch. The crossing strokes break continuity between the two panels and come close to the 'never a cross' rule.
minors.evidence: 8x zoom at about x990-1050, y770-850 on page 1: white radiating strokes cross at a centre point, like an asterisk. 1.3 shows a broad ridged patch with no single crossing.

minors.description: Nagoji's hands are bare: only a wrist band shows on one wrist, and the other hand has no linen at all. Page 1 (1.1, 1.3) wraps both hands fully in linen, as the pages 1-2 override says. 2.5 also shows only wrist bands with bare palms and fingers.
minors.evidence: Crop of 2.3 at about x960-1260, y1450-1630: one wrapped wrist, two bare clasped hands, and no wrap on the second hand. In 1.1 both hands are mitten-wrapped in linen strips.

minors.description: The faint chafe rings at the ankles are drawn as thin, crisp red cords around both ankles. They read as red thread anklets, not healed chafe marks.
minors.evidence: Zoom of the ankles in 1.1 (about x680-1000, y850-990): a clean thin red line circles each ankle like a tied thread.

minors.description: Nagoji's sleeves are pushed up to the elbows and the left forearm is bare across his knee, against the instruction to keep the left sleeve down over the brand. In 3.1 the sleeves are also only three-quarter length, not the long sleeves the script specifies.
minors.evidence: Crop of 5.4 at about x300-760, y1360-1720: rolled sleeves above both elbows, bare forearms, wrist wraps. In 3.1 the cuffs stop mid-forearm just above the wraps.

minors.description: Nagoji's hair hangs loose to his shoulders. From page 3 the costume calls for it tied back, and it is tied back in 3.1, 3.5 and 4.2.
minors.evidence: Close-up in 3.3: full loose curls frame his face and fall onto both shoulders, with no visible tie. In 3.5 the same hair is gathered in a low knot at the nape.

minors.description: Ibrahim faces three-quarter to screen right, so his right cheek is toward camera, yet a short scar-like stroke is drawn on that right cheekbone. The left ear-to-jaw scar is hidden, and the mark reads as a mirrored scar.
minors.evidence: Crop of Ibrahim's head in 3.5 (about x1000-1260, y2080-2330): a diagonal pale stroke on the cheekbone, on the camera-facing (right) side of his face.

minors.description: Ibrahim's face shows neither the ash smear the script tags for this panel ('faint ash') nor the scar, although his left cheek faces camera. The ash is also hard to see in 6.1. It is clear in 5.4, 6.2, 6.3, 7.1, 7.4 and 9.1.
minors.evidence: 6x zoom of Ibrahim's head in 8.1 (about x1100-1230, y610-720): clean forehead under the turban, and no pale line from ear to jaw on the visible left cheek.

minors.description: Ibrahim wears sandals inside the hall in 8.1 but stands barefoot in the same hall in 9.1. Nagoji is barefoot in both.
minors.evidence: 8.1 shows dark leather sandals on Ibrahim's feet below his mundu (about x1180-1240, y1060-1100 at full size). In 9.1 both of Ibrahim's feet are bare on the wooden floor.

minors.description: The official's costume has drifted. In 9.1 his shoulder cloth and mundu have gold kasavu borders and his topknot has a gold band, and 6.4 also shows a gold-bordered mundu. The script calls for a plain shoulder cloth and white mundu, which is how 6.3, 7.4 and 7.5 draw him. His face in 9.1 is also rounder, with darker hair, than in 6.5 and 7.5.
minors.evidence: Zoom of the official in 9.1 (about x1350-1580, y600-800): gold stripes along the shoulder cloth and a gold ring at the topknot. The mundu at his lap has a gold border in both 6.4 and 9.1.

minors.description: The record prop changes between panels on the same page. In 6.3 the official writes on what reads as a broad white paper sheet over a flat golden board. In 6.5 he holds a single narrow wooden plank. 7.2 and 7.5 show the scripted bundle of palm leaves.
minors.evidence: Zoom of the official in 6.3 (about x1150-1440, y1560-1830): a white rectangular sheet under the stylus and a gilt tablet in the other hand. In 6.5 he holds a thin wooden board under the stylus.

minors.description: In the reverse shot the official sits against a tall, carved, high-backed wooden chair. 6.3, 6.4 and 9.1 seat him cross-legged on a low raised dais with no chair back.
minors.evidence: Left foreground of 8.1: an ornate carved chair back with a turned finial behind the official's bare shoulder. In 9.1 he sits on a cushion on a low carved dais.

minors.description: The time of day jumps. 4.2 is lit with a bright midday blue sky and white clouds, between the golden late-afternoon light of 4.1 (and all of page 3) and the dusk of 4.3.
minors.evidence: The 4.2 background shows a pale blue sky and green paddies in full daylight. 4.1 has an orange sunset sky, and 4.3 has a dark blue dusk sky with fireflies.

minors.description: The guards behind the official wear red or maroon waist sashes. The script specifies dark sashes, and the gate guards in 6.1 wear dark indigo ones.
minors.evidence: 6.4 background: two Nair guards with spears and round shields wear deep red sashes at the waist. The 6.1 gate guards have dark blue-black sashes.

minors.description: Ibrahim's scar is painted as a raw red cut with cross-hatched stitch-like ticks, so it reads as a fresh, half-bleeding wound and not an old healed scar. That brushes against the no-blood rule and breaks continuity: the script and pages 1.4 and 1.5 have it as a bare pale line.
minors.evidence: Zoomed crops: in 4.5 the line running from the ear to the jaw under his thumb is saturated red with small perpendicular tick marks. 4.4 and 5.1 show the same red, stitched look. On page 1 (1.4, 1.5) the same scar is a thin pale line, which is correct.

minors.description: The background Nair guard at screen right wears a wide leather waist belt with a large rectangular roller buckle over his mundu. It reads like a modern trouser belt. The bible gives Travancore troops crossed leather belts only, and the waist-belt-and-buckle look recurs on the standing guards in 8.1.
minors.evidence: Crop of the right edge of 7.5: a brown belt with a squared metal buckle sits at the guard's waist under his crossed straps. Guards along the back wall in 8.1 show similar buckled waist belts.

minors.description: The hall floor is a mirror-polished surface, almost like lacquer. In 8.3 it looks like glossy stone tile with grid joints and strong reflections of the lamps. That reads as a modern interior, but the script specifies a packed-earth floor for this coastal official's hall.
minors.evidence: In 8.3 the floor behind the seated men shows tile seams and bright specular reflections of the brass lamps and pillars. 8.1 and 9.1 show the same high-gloss plank floor with reflected lamp flames.

minors.description: The two-box bow caption steps down from upper right to lower left, and the boxes touch at a corner, so the eye can land on "but as a man..." before "Not as a subject, not yet,". The boxes also sit over Nagoji's hands and waist and the official's palm-leaf bundle. The script puts them in the foreground space around Nagoji's lowered head.
minors.evidence: page-09.png at full resolution: "Not as a subject, not yet," is at about (1033-1359, 888-978) and overlaps the official's hand and leaf bundle. "but as a man who understands..." is at about (438-1029, 982-1114), across Nagoji's hands and torso. Nagoji's head (about 560-740, 500-620) has no lettering near it.

minors.description: The script asks for all lettering to stay on Nagoji's side of the frame so Ibrahim's wordless flicker reads cleanly. Instead the narration caption and the "Who is your king?" balloon sit in the middle third, with the caption's right edge almost touching Ibrahim's turban and beard. This crowds the silent beat.
minors.evidence: page-01.png at full resolution: the caption box is at about (675-1024, 2173-2383) and the balloon at about (672-958, 2400-2525). Ibrahim's turban and beard start at about x 1068. Nagoji's figure takes only x 307-620.

minors.description: Tier 3 has stepped edges. Panel 1.4 sits about 28 px higher and 28 px lower than 1.3, so the gutters above and below 1.4 shrink to about 6 px while 1.3 has about 34 px. Panels 1.2 and 1.5 are also inset about 160-180 px on each side, so the page's left and right edges are noticeably ragged.
minors.evidence: page-01.png at full resolution: 1.3 spans y 1452-2139 and 1.4 spans y 1424-2167. 1.2 spans x 325-1512 and 1.5 spans x 307-1529, while the page margins are 148-1688.

minors.description: The off-panel tail for Ibrahim's "And for kings. That too." stops inside the pepper vine and does not break the panel border. It reads as pointing at the vine rather than at a speaker outside the frame.
minors.evidence: page-03.png: the tail tip is at about (1672,832) full-res, inside the vine leaves and about 16 px short of the right border (x 1688).

minors.description: The boy's "<Who is he?>" tail stops in the air above the running boys, closer to Ibrahim's raised thumb than to the pointing boy. Because Ibrahim's reply sits directly below, a reader could take both lines as Ibrahim's.
minors.evidence: page-05.png at full resolution: the tail tip is at about (343,1011). The pointing boy's hand is at about (353,1056) and his head lower. Ibrahim's raised thumb is at about (403,991).

minors.description: The whispered lines are lettered in ordinary solid balloons with no whisper treatment, such as a dashed outline or smaller type. The first tail stops in the pillar and lamp area about 100 px from Ibrahim's face. The second balloon butts right against the official's shoulder, so at a glance the official seems to say "This is one of his hands on this coast."
minors.evidence: page-06.png at full resolution: the first tail tip is at about (847,1446), while Ibrahim's face is at x 582-742. The second balloon's right edge is at about x 1247, against the official's shoulder at about x 1252.

minors.description: The official's second balloon covers his hands and the palm leaf. That hides the scripted action of him tapping the edge of the leaf with the stylus; only the stylus tip and the top of the bundle show.
minors.evidence: page-07.png at full resolution: the top of the balloon is at about y 1675, cutting across the official's hands and leaf at about (1290-1500, 1625-1680).

minors.description: Panel 7.1 is a short, narrow strip set about 285 px in from each margin. Nagoji's head touches the top border, which cramps the upright "Nagoji Sawant." beat that answers the platform.
minors.evidence: page-07.png at full resolution: the panel spans x 433-1404 and y 358-684. The top of Nagoji's hair meets the top border at about (800,360).

minors.description: Ibrahim's line is marked IBRAHIM (small) in the script but is lettered at full size in a large balloon. The balloon also covers the left half of the distant Kerala temple roof.
minors.evidence: page-04.png at full resolution: the balloon is at about (1212-1572, 1015-1245) and overlaps the temple roof at about x 1522-1572. Its type size matches the full-size balloons in 4.4.

minors.description: The final caption, scripted as "separate, weighted", is lettered exactly like the other three. Two of the four captions sit on the wall and across Nagoji's legs instead of in the moonlit sky the script asks for.
minors.evidence: page-09.png at full resolution: "When sleep came..." is at about (688-1293, 2094-2264), over Nagoji's body. "Horses. Guns. Storms." is on the wall at about (1315-1615, 2010-2095). All four boxes share the same border, fill and type.

minors.description: The second caption, "He had decided what kind of man I was...", sits across the healer's back and arms and hides her work at the hearth.
minors.evidence: page-01.png at full resolution: the caption is at about (222-788, 641-770) and covers the healer's torso and arms at about (330-625, 600-830).

minors.description: The boy's '<Who is he?>' tail ends between the pointing boy's hand and Ibrahim's raised thumb, about equally close to both. It can read as Ibrahim asking the question he then answers himself. The pointing boy aims at Ibrahim's gesture rather than clearly at Nagoji.
minors.evidence: Crop of 5.2: tail tip at about (195,205). The pointing boy's head is at about (125,250) and Ibrahim's thumb at about (255,185). Nagoji sits on the sacks at about (480,150).

minors.description: The script asks for Nagoji in the foreground with the bow captions in the space around his lowered head. Here Nagoji stands mid-left at the same depth as the official. The first caption, 'Not as a subject, not yet,', sits against the official's shoulder, so it reads as attached to the official rather than to Nagoji's bow.
minors.evidence: The 'Not as a subject, not yet,' box is at about (745-980, 640-705), touching the official's arm. The 'but as a man...' box sits beside Nagoji's waist rather than near his lowered head.

minors.description: The script asks for all captions in the moonlit sky, the last one as a separate weighted box, and the camera slightly high. The final caption ('When sleep came...') is laid over Nagoji's sleeping body, covering his hip and legs. It has no weighted treatment that sets it apart from the other boxes. The camera is at ground level, not high.
minors.evidence: The final caption box spans about x 495-935, y 1510-1635 in display coordinates, directly over Nagoji's torso and dhoti on the mat. Its border and type style match the three captions above it.

minors.description: The script asks for single file with Ibrahim's white turban leading and Nagoji's head turned to catch the pepper scent. The two men walk side by side toward camera, Nagoji slightly ahead, both facing forward. The scent-catching beat that sets up 'Pepper.' is lost.
minors.evidence: Crop of 3.2: Nagoji at left and Ibrahim at right walk abreast on the paddy bund. Nagoji's head faces straight ahead.

minors.description: Ibrahim should lead Nagoji inland. Instead they walk abreast with Nagoji half a step ahead, and Nagoji's head is cropped at the top border in this establishing wide.
minors.evidence: Crop of 3.1: Nagoji's hair and crown are cut by the panel's top edge at about x 600-700. Ibrahim walks level with him or slightly behind.

minors.description: The panel is lit as bright midday blue sky, between the sunset of 4.1 and the dusk of 4.3, which breaks the slow fall into dusk. Nagoji's linen-wrapped hand closing on Ibrahim's does not read: the clasp shows a sleeve and a bare-looking hand.
minors.evidence: Crop of 4.2: clear blue sky with white clouds, compared with the orange sunset in 4.1 and the deep-blue dusk with fireflies in 4.3. The clasped hands at about (390,300) in the crop show no visible bandage.

minors.description: The insert should show the stylus cutting strokes into the palm leaf, echoing the Chapter 1 ledger: the name being written down. The stylus is held upright above a thick bound stack and nothing is being incised, so the echo is weak.
minors.evidence: Crop of 7.2: the stylus tip hovers over the leaf stack with no visible marks or strokes on the top leaf.

minors.description: Nagoji's head is clipped by the top border of this short strip panel. He faces out toward the camera and upward instead of answering the platform, which is at screen right.
minors.evidence: Crop of 7.1: the top of Nagoji's hair is cut at the panel edge. His face points toward the viewer, while the official's knee and arm show at the right edge.

minors.description: The script calls for a narrow side-on panel with the slight smile just starting at the corner of the official's mouth. It is drawn as a full-width tier, and the official already wears a broad, eye-crinkling smile, which gives away the turn before the 9.1 lines.
minors.evidence: 8.3 spans the full page width at about 150 pt tall. The official's face at top right shows a full closed-mouth grin.

minors.description: The script asks for Ibrahim's gaze to slide toward the bright doorway and the sea, with all lettering kept on Nagoji's side. No doorway or sea is in frame (the background is a lamp-lit interior wall). The caption box sits at the centre line, butting against Ibrahim's beard and turban.
minors.evidence: Crop of 1.5: the caption spans about 487-738 of a 222-1100 display panel, crossing the midpoint, and its right edge touches Ibrahim's face. Behind Ibrahim there is only a lamp on a shelf.

minors.description: Both of Ibrahim's lines are tagged (whisper) in the script, but they are lettered as ordinary solid balloons at full size, so the whisper treatment is lost.
minors.evidence: 'This is not the king. He is busy elsewhere.' and 'This is one of his hands on this coast.' use the same solid outline and type weight as normal dialogue on the page.

minors.description: The script tags Ibrahim's line (small), a quiet line in a wide establishing shot. The balloon is lettered at full size and takes about a third of the panel, covering sky and the far landscape.
minors.evidence: The 'Rest. The road is long, and the bulls do not hurry.' balloon spans about x 870-1130, y 735-895 in a 665-1216 by 712-1062 display panel.
